title: Puzzle AI suite band
description: A full-width deep violet band with faint pixel squares in its corners: a centred white eyebrow, headline, paragraph and outline button, then a two-column grid pairing translucent feature cards (icon tile, title, small pill, text, a media frame) with powder panels holding a built chat exchange — question bubbles, an answer card with three figure tiles, or a review table with two buttons. Closes with a hairline-framed strip of text and two buttons. Everything stacks on phones.
notes: the band is primary-coloured with primary-foreground text; best with a dark brand colour
the chat bubbles and review table are real text from props; the feature cards' media slots are placeholders until filled
flagged rows in the review table use the chart-5 colour
